moments.title: Her father-in-law's travel insurance claim in London paid out nothing
moments.summary: A participant recounts a live example: her father-in-law was treated in London with travel and medical insurance in place, but when the claim papers went in they were told to pay the whole amount, and nothing was reimbursed.
moments.evidence: But when we had to put in the papers for the claim, they said, sorry, you have to pay the world amount.
